name: Ollama List Models
content:
"""
Title: Ollama List Models
Description: List all models pulled into the local Ollama server.
"""

import urllib.request
import urllib.error
import json
import os


class Tools:
    def list_models(self) -> str:
        """
        List all models available on the Ollama server.
        Returns a formatted table of model name, size, and modification date.
        """
        base_url = os.environ.get("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://ollama_server:11434").rstrip("/")
        url = f"{base_url}/api/tags"
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10) as resp:
                data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            return f"Error reaching Ollama at {url}: {exc}"
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            return f"Error parsing Ollama response: {exc}"

        models = data.get("models", [])
        if not models:
            return "No models pulled yet. Run `task pull -- -m <model>` to add one."

        lines = [f"{'NAME':<32} {'SIZE':>12}  MODIFIED", "-" * 60]
        for model in models:
            name = model.get("name", "?")
            size_bytes = model.get("size", 0)
            size_str = self._format_bytes(size_bytes)
            modified = model.get("modified_at", "?")[:19]
            lines.append(f"{name:<32} {size_str:>12}  {modified}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _format_bytes(self, num: float) -> str:
        for unit in ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"]:
            if num < 1024.0:
                return f"{num:.1f} {unit}"
            num /= 1024.0
        return f"{num:.1f} PB"

meta.description: List all models pulled into the local Ollama server via the /api/tags endpoint.

name: Ollama Model Info
content:
"""
Title: Ollama Model Info
Description: Show details (size, parameters, template, quantization) for a pulled Ollama model.
"""

import urllib.request
import urllib.error
import json
import os


class Tools:
    def model_info(self, model_name: str) -> str:
        """
        Show details for a specific Ollama model.
        Args:
            model_name: The model identifier (e.g. "llama3.2:1b").
        """
        base_url = os.environ.get("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://ollama_server:11434").rstrip("/")
        url = f"{base_url}/api/show"
        payload = json.dumps({"name": model_name}).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, method="POST")
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
                data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            return f"Ollama returned HTTP {exc.code} for model '{model_name}'. Is it pulled?"
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            return f"Error reaching Ollama: {exc}"

        lines = [f"Model: {model_name}"]
        details = data.get("details", {})
        if details:
            lines.append(f"  Family:        {details.get('family', '?')}")
            lines.append(f"  Parameter size: {details.get('parameter_size', '?')}")
            lines.append(f"  Quantization:  {details.get('quantization_level', '?')}")
        info = data.get("model_info", {})
        if info:
            arch = info.get("general.architecture", "?")
            lines.append(f"  Architecture:   {arch}")
        params = data.get("parameters", "")
        if params:
            lines.append(f"  Parameters:     {params}")
        template = data.get("template", "")
        if template:
            lines.append(f"  Template:       {template[:120]}{'...' if len(template) > 120 else ''}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

meta.description: Show details (size, parameters, template, quantization) for a specific pulled Ollama model.

name: Ollama Server Status
content:
"""
Title: Ollama Server Status
Description: Check Ollama server health and list currently loaded (in-memory) models.
"""

import urllib.request
import urllib.error
import json
import os


class Tools:
    def server_status(self) -> str:
        """
        Check the Ollama server health and list models currently loaded in memory.
        """
        base_url = os.environ.get("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://ollama_server:11434").rstrip("/")
        lines = ["=== Ollama Server Status ===", ""]

        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{base_url}/api/tags", timeout=5) as resp:
                data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
            lines.append("API: REACHABLE")
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            lines.append(f"API: UNREACHABLE ({exc})")
            return "\n".join(lines)

        pulled = data.get("models", [])
        lines.append(f"Pulled models: {len(pulled)}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("Loaded models (in memory):")

        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{base_url}/api/ps", timeout=5) as resp:
                ps_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
            loaded = ps_data.get("models", [])
            if not loaded:
                lines.append("  (none loaded)")
            for model in loaded:
                name = model.get("name", "?")
                size = model.get("size_vram", 0) or model.get("size", 0)
                expires = model.get("expires_at", "?")
                lines.append(f"  {name}  size={self._fmt(size)}  expires={expires[:19]}")
        except urllib.error.URLError:
            lines.append("  (could not query /api/ps)")

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _fmt(self, num: float) -> str:
        for unit in ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"]:
            if num < 1024.0:
                return f"{num:.1f}{unit}"
            num /= 1024.0
        return f"{num:.1f}PB"

meta.description: Check Ollama server health and list currently loaded (in-memory) models via /api/ps.

name: Ollama Hardware Detect
content:
"""
Title: Ollama Hardware Detect
Description: Detect host GPU type and recommend Docker Compose configuration for ollama-portable.
"""

import subprocess
import shutil
import platform


class Tools:
    def detect_hardware(self) -> str:
        """
        Detect the host GPU and recommend the Docker Compose configuration.
        Mirrors scripts/detect.sh logic. Returns GPU type, compose files, and system info.
        """
        gpu_type = "none"
        compose_files = "-f docker-compose.yml"

        if shutil.which("nvidia-smi") and self._runs("nvidia-smi"):
            gpu_type = "nvidia"
            compose_files = "-f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu-nvidia.yml"
        elif shutil.which("rocm-smi") and self._runs("rocm-smi"):
            gpu_type = "amd"
            compose_files = "-f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu-amd.yml"
        elif shutil.which("amd-smi") and self._runs("amd-smi"):
            gpu_type = "amd"
            compose_files = "-f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu-amd.yml"
        elif platform.system() == "Darwin":
            try:
                cpu_brand = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["sysctl", "-n", "machdep.cpu.brand_string"],
                    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True
                ).strip()
                if "Apple" in cpu_brand:
                    gpu_type = "apple"
            except Exception:
                pass

        lines = ["=== Hardware Detection ===", ""]
        label = {
            "nvidia": "NVIDIA GPU",
            "amd": "AMD GPU",
            "apple": "Apple Silicon (Metal)",
            "none": "CPU-only (no supported GPU)",
        }.get(gpu_type, gpu_type)
        lines.append(f"GPU: {label}")
        lines.append(f"Compose files: {compose_files}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("System Info:")
        lines.append(f"  OS:      {platform.system()} {platform.release()}")
        lines.append(f"  Machine: {platform.machine()}")
        lines.append(f"  Python:  {platform.python_version()}")

        if gpu_type == "none":
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("Recommended models (CPU-only):")
            lines.append("  <16GB RAM: qwen2.5:0.5b, llama3.2:1b (3-10 tok/s)")
            lines.append("  16GB+ RAM: qwen2.5:1.5b, deepseek-r1:1.5b (2-5 tok/s)")
        elif gpu_type in ("nvidia", "amd"):
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("Recommended models (GPU):")
            lines.append("  Any up to 7B with GPU acceleration")
        elif gpu_type == "apple":
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("Recommended models (Apple Silicon):")
            lines.append("  Any up to 7B with Metal acceleration")

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _runs(self, cmd: str) -> bool:
        try:
            subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True, timeout=5)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

meta.description: Detect host GPU (NVIDIA/AMD/Apple/CPU) and recommend Docker Compose config and models for ollama-portable.

name: Ollama Recommend Model
content:
"""
Title: Ollama Recommend Model
Description: Recommend an Ollama model based on available RAM and GPU, with expected tokens/second.
"""

import os


class Tools:
    def recommend_model(self, ram_gb: int, use_case: str = "general") -> str:
        """
        Recommend an Ollama model for the given RAM and use case.
        Args:
            ram_gb: Available system RAM in gigabytes.
            use_case: One of 'general', 'coding', 'reasoning', 'vision', 'small'.
        """
        use_case = use_case.lower().strip()
        ram = float(ram_gb)

        catalog = {
            "general": [
                ("qwen2.5:0.5b", 1, 1, "3-10 tok/s on CPU, instant on GPU"),
                ("llama3.2:1b", 2, 4, "3-10 tok/s on CPU, fast on GPU"),
                ("qwen2.5:1.5b", 4, 4, "2-5 tok/s on CPU, fast on GPU"),
                ("llama3.2:3b", 6, 8, "slow on CPU, good on GPU"),
                ("mistral:7b", 8, 16, "GPU recommended"),
                ("qwen2.5:7b", 8, 16, "GPU recommended"),
            ],
            "coding": [
                ("qwen2.5-coder:1.5b", 4, 4, "2-5 tok/s on CPU"),
                ("qwen2.5-coder:3b", 6, 8, "slow on CPU, good on GPU"),
                ("qwen2.5-coder:7b", 8, 16, "GPU recommended"),
                ("deepseek-coder-v2:16b", 16, 32, "GPU strongly recommended"),
            ],
            "reasoning": [
                ("deepseek-r1:1.5b", 4, 4, "2-5 tok/s on CPU"),
                ("deepseek-r1:7b", 8, 16, "GPU recommended"),
                ("deepseek-r1:8b", 8, 16, "GPU recommended"),
                ("deepseek-r1:14b", 16, 32, "GPU strongly recommended"),
            ],
            "vision": [
                ("llava:7b", 8, 16, "GPU recommended"),
                ("llava:13b", 16, 32, "GPU strongly recommended"),
                ("minicpm-v:8b", 8, 16, "GPU recommended"),
            ],
            "small": [
                ("qwen2.5:0.5b", 1, 1, "3-10 tok/s on CPU, instant on GPU"),
                ("llama3.2:1b", 2, 4, "3-10 tok/s on CPU"),
                ("qwen2.5:1.5b", 4, 4, "2-5 tok/s on CPU"),
            ],
        }

        options = catalog.get(use_case, catalog["general"])
        lines = [f"=== Model Recommendations ({use_case}) ===", f"RAM available: {ram_gb} GB", ""]
        best = None
        for name, min_ram, rec_ram, note in options:
            fits = "YES" if ram >= min_ram else "NO"
            tag = "*BEST*" if (ram >= rec_ram and best is None) else ""
            if ram >= rec_ram and best is None:
                best = name
            lines.append(f"  {name:<28} min={min_ram}GB rec={rec_ram}GB  fits={fits}  {tag}")
            lines.append(f"    {note}")
        lines.append("")
        if best:
            lines.append(f"Recommended: {best}")
            lines.append(f"Pull with: task pull -- -m {best}")
        else:
            lines.append("No model fits available RAM. Consider a smaller use case or more RAM.")
        return "\n".join(lines)

meta.description: Recommend an Ollama model based on available RAM and use case (general, coding, reasoning, vision, small).

name: Ollama Pull Model
content:
"""
Title: Ollama Pull Model
Description: Pull a model into the Ollama server. Streams progress. Use sparingly — pulls can be large.
"""

import urllib.request
import urllib.error
import json
import os


class Tools:
    def pull_model(self, model_name: str) -> str:
        """
        Pull a model into the Ollama server. Returns a summary when done.
        Args:
            model_name: The model to pull (e.g. "llama3.2:1b").
        """
        base_url = os.environ.get("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://ollama_server:11434").rstrip("/")
        url = f"{base_url}/api/pull"
        payload = json.dumps({"name": model_name, "stream": False}).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, method="POST")
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as resp:
                data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            return f"Pull failed: HTTP {exc.code} - {exc.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[:200]}"
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            return f"Error reaching Ollama: {exc}"

        status = data.get("status", "unknown")
        total = data.get("total", 0)
        completed = data.get("completed", 0)
        if total:
            pct = (completed / total * 100) if total else 0
            return f"Pull complete: {model_name}  status={status}  {completed}/{total} bytes ({pct:.1f}%)"
        return f"Pull complete: {model_name}  status={status}"

meta.description: Pull a model into the Ollama server via /api/pull. Streams progress and returns a summary. Use sparingly — pulls can be large.

name: Ollama Delete Model
content:
"""
Title: Ollama Delete Model
Description: Remove a model from the Ollama server to free disk space. Requires confirmation in the prompt.
"""

import urllib.request
import urllib.error
import json
import os


class Tools:
    def delete_model(self, model_name: str, confirm: bool = False) -> str:
        """
        Delete a model from the Ollama server.
        Args:
            model_name: The model to delete (e.g. "llama3.2:1b").
            confirm: Must be True to actually delete. Safety gate.
        """
        if not confirm:
            return (f"Deletion of '{model_name}' NOT confirmed. "
                    "Call again with confirm=True to proceed. This is a safety gate.")

        base_url = os.environ.get("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://ollama_server:11434").rstrip("/")
        url = f"{base_url}/api/delete"
        payload = json.dumps({"name": model_name}).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, method="DELETE")
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                if resp.status == 200:
                    return f"Deleted: {model_name}"
                return f"Delete returned status {resp.status}"
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            if exc.code == 404:
                return f"Model '{model_name}' not found. Already deleted?"
            return f"Delete failed: HTTP {exc.code}"
        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
            return f"Error reaching Ollama: {exc}"

meta.description: Delete a model from the Ollama server via /api/delete. Has a confirm safety gate to prevent accidental deletion.
